sources.note: Panicuason, Mt. Isarog Natural Park, approximately 40-foot drop and receiving pond. Access times, fees and hours are not asserted.

sources.title: Monette Nyem: Malabsay Falls, 30 October 2011 (CC BY 3.0)
sources.note: Original 1024×680 photograph inspected directly 2026-10-08. Narrow fall against dark rock, broad plunge pool, mossy outlet boulders and leafy/fern banks guide the plan-view impression. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/ . No bitmap ships. Its distant geotag is not used to place the falls.

sources.title: herbert joey: Malabsayfalls, 31 October 2005 (CC BY-SA 2.0)

sources.title: Esri World Imagery: overhead forest context
sources.note: North-up z17/z18 source tiles inspected directly 2026-10-08 around the OSM point. Dense canopy and shadow obscure water edges; no surveyed pool outline, individual trunks or flow bearing can be derived. Capture date unknown.

sources.title: Draft plan-view placement and limits
sources.note: Photo-informed natural forms, not surveyed geometry: about 15 m across and 13 m long for the pool; a narrow crest at the OSM point, asymmetric rock ledge and grouped outlet boulders. Pool/outlet are provisionally southwest of the anchor; bearing, scale and all vegetation boundaries are estimates. Ground photographs establish appearance, not north/south orientation. No added trail, stairway, furniture, concrete, species or historical dates. The complete mapped hiking path is untouched; no mapped stream connects to the point.
